name: Scarlet Leprosy
body:
Type disease (injury); Save Fortitude DC 20

Incubation 1d3 days; Frequency 1/day

Effect 1d6 Con and 1d6 Cha damage; whenever a character suffers Con damage, 1 point is permanent drain.

A carrion golem transmits scarlet leprosy on a successful slam attack.
